depiction.primary_object: pointing hand with extended index finger
modifiers: figure-eight ribbon tied around the index finger
depiction.composition: single stylized line-art object, front view

readings.meaning: reminder / don't forget (string tied on a finger)
touch gesture or tap with loop

ambiguity: At small sizes, the finger with the double loop looks like a sprout, flower, scissors handle, or the Cyrillic letter Ф / Greek letter phi emerging from a pot.

modifier_semantics.modifier: figure-eight ribbon tied around the index finger
modifier_semantics.meaning: traditional knot-on-finger mnemonic for remembering not to forget something

task_intents: note down things not to forget

reasoning: The icon depicts a hand with a figure-eight string tied around the index finger, the classic visual idiom for a reminder or 'don't forget'. Because every task in a to-do list is already a reminder, it is only the best choice when the task itself is about setting up reminders or memorizing information; at small sizes it can also be misread as a seedling in a pot or a Greek phi symbol.
